messages:
Nadia H: Follow-up from PMTKT-4862 postmortem. We saw repeated leader election churn and delayed healthchecks. Need to land runbook edits, assign owners, and set timelines. I'm compiling a single follow-up checklist.
Ethan Q: I'll own the automated runbook test and add a CI job that simulates a controlled leader election and verifies smoke checks pass. ETA: 2025-08-05.
Sylvie L: I'll update the Quick Triage section with exact commands and add a 'first 5 minutes' checklist. Draft commands below:
```
# cluster pods
kubectl get pods -l app=redwood-shard -o wide
# check leader metric
max_over_time(leader_election_age_seconds[1m])
# tail recent errors
journalctl -u redwood-service --since "15 minutes ago" | rg "leader-election|election.*failed" -n
```
Marco P: I'll own escalation thresholds + contact table. Proposal: escalate to infra when leader_age > 90s for 5m OR > 120s for 2m, or >1 failover in 24h. I'll document phone/Slack rotations. ETA: 2025-08-01.
Nadia H: Can we add a 'recurring incident' label automation? If similar signature found in last 30d, auto-tag the ticket. Also increase leader-election log retention to 30d for triage.
ops-bot: PMTKT-4862 follow-ups created: RBK-201, TEST-77, ALERT-912.
incident-bot: severity set to P2 at 1751234567. Follow-ups required.
Ethan Q: CI job plan: create k8s job to cordon one node, drain a shard, trigger election, then run smoke script that checks leader_age and sample traffic. Failures will post to #smoke-fails and create TEST-77.
Sylvie L: Quick Triage addition: include one-liner 'when to escalate to infra' at top and a 6-step checklist: 1) check pods, 2) read leader_age, 3) check recent error logs, 4) verify dashboards, 5) attempt safe remediation (cordon/drain), 6) escalate if thresholds met.
Marco P: I'll add a decision tree image and a minimal spreadsheet of contacts. Also adding an auto-escalate hook in alert payload when sustained leader_age >120s for 10m.
Nadia H: Action items & ETAs: - Quick Triage updates: Sylvie L, ETA 2025-07-29; - Escalation matrix + contacts: Marco P, ETA 2025-08-01; - CI runbook test (TEST-77): Ethan Q, ETA 2025-08-05; - Recurring-incident automation + log retention: Nadia H, ETA 2025-07-31; - Dry-run tabletop with oncall: Sylvie L & Ethan Q, date 2025-08-06.
Ethan Q: Adding small grep helper for runbook: `rg "(leader-election|election).*error|panic" /var/log/redwood/*.log -n --context 5`
Sylvie L: I'll include dashboard links (leader_age, failover_count) and a short smoke-check script in the runbook.
Marco P: Filing alert PR ALERT-912 and wiring runbook links into the alerts.
Nadia H: Please react with :white_check_mark: if you accept ownership so I can close follow-ups in the ticket. Target: close all action items in two weeks.
Ethan Q: :white_check_mark:
Sylvie L: :white_check_mark: I'll put up a PR today for Quick Triage.
Marco P: :white_check_mark: adding contact table and decision tree.
incident-bot: Reminder set: follow-up review in 7 days.
